name: Montreal Protocol
description: The Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer is an international treaty designed to protect the ozone layer by phasing out the production of numerous substances that are responsible for ozone depletion.
relevanceToAfrica: Essential for technology transfer and funding to transition away from ozone-depleting substances.

name: Basel Convention
description: The Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and Their Disposal is an international treaty that was designed to reduce the movements of hazardous waste between nations, and specifically to prevent transfer of hazardous waste from developed to less developed countries (LDCs).
relevanceToAfrica: Crucial for preventing the dumping of e-waste and other hazardous materials in African countries.

name: Bamako Convention
description: The Bamako Convention is a treaty of African nations prohibiting the import into Africa of any hazardous (including radioactive) waste.
keyProvisions: Total ban on the import of hazardous wastes into Africa
Control of transboundary movement within Africa
relevanceToAfrica: Africa's own response to the perceived weaknesses of the Basel Convention.

name: Kigali Amendment
description: The Kigali Amendment to the Montreal Protocol is an international agreement to gradually reduce the consumption and production of hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).
relevanceToAfrica: Crucial for climate change mitigation while improving cooling access and energy efficiency.
